Version %2$s, %1$s
Start again to update to version %3$s
Start by connecting to a computer
For devices without root, you need to use adb to start Xiluoya (requires computer connection). This process needs to be repeated every time the device is restarted. Please read the help.

%1$s

* There are some other considerations, please confirm that you have read the help first.

On Android 11 or above, you can enable Wireless debugging and start Xiluoya directly from your device, without connecting to a computer.

Please view the step-by-step guide first.
Before Android 11, connecting to a computer is required to enable Wireless debugging.

Please enable \"Wireless debugging\" in \"Developer options\". \"Wireless debugging\" is automatically disabled when network changes.\n\nNote, do not disable \"Developer options\" or \"USB debugging\", or Xiluoya will be stopped.
Please try to disable and enable \"Wireless debugging\" if it keeps searching.
Port is an integer ranging from 1 to 65535.
Can\'t connect to wireless debugging service.
Wireless debugging is not enabled.\nNote, before Android 11, to enable wireless debugging, computer connection is a must.

Please start paring by the following steps: \"Developer Options\" - \"Wireless debugging\" - \"Pairing device using pairing code\".\n\nAfter the pairing process starts, you will able to input the pairing code.
The system requires the pairing dialog always visible, using split-screen mode is the only way to let this app and system dialog visible at the same time.
Unable to generate key for wireless debugging.\nThis may be because KeyStore mechanism of this device is broken.
Please go through the pairing step first.
A notification from Xiluoya will help you complete the pairing.
Enter \"Developer options\" - \"Wireless debugging\". Tap \"Pair device with pairing code\", you will see a six-digit code.
Enter the code in the notification to complete pairing.
The pairing process needs you to interact with a notification from Xiluoya. Please allow Xiluoya to post notifications.
MIUI users may need to switch notification style to \"Android\" from \"Notification\" - \"Notification shade\" in system settings.
Otherwise, you may not able to enter paring code from the notification.
Please note, left part of the \"Wireless debugging\" option is clickable, tapping it will open a new page. Only turing on the switch on the right is incorrect.
Back to Xiluoya and start Xiluoya.
Xiluoya needs to access local network. It is controlled by the network permission.

Some systems (such as MIUI) disallow apps to access the network when they are not visible, even if the app uses foreground service as standard. Please disable battery optimization features for Xiluoya on such systems.

In addition, Xiluoya can be started automatically on boot. If not, please check if your system or third-party tools have restricted Xiluoya.
You can refer to %s.
If you are using Magisk, you can try %1$s. For root users, it will eventually replace Xiluoya. Note, existing applications needs to change a little to use %2$s.
Apps that has requested or declared Xiluoya will show here.
Learn how to develop with Xiluoya
You need to take an extra step

Your device manufacturer has restricted adb permissions and apps using Xiluoya will not work properly.

Usually, this limitation can be lifted by adjusting some options in "Developer options". Please read the help for details on how to do this.

You may need to restart Xiluoya for the operation to take effect.
The permission of adb is limited

It\'s highly possible that your device manufacturer limits the permission of adb.

There may be a solution for your system in this document.
Run commands through Xiluoya in terminal apps you like
First, Export files to any where you want. You will find two files, %1$s and %2$s.

If there are files with the same name in the selected folder, they will be deleted.\n\nThe export function uses SAF (Storage Access Framework). It\'s reported that MIUI breaks the functions of SAF. If you are using MIUI, you may have to extract the file from Xiluoya\'s apk or download from GitHub.
Then, use any text editor to open and edit %1$s.
For example, if you want to use Xiluoya in %1$s, you should replace %2$s with %3$s (%4$s is the package name of %1$s).
Finally, move the files to somewhere where your terminal app can access, you will be able to use %1$s to run commands through Xiluoya.
Some tips: grant execute permission to %1$s and add it to %2$s, you will able to use %1$s directly.

With %1$s, in any terminal app, you can connect to and interact with the shell runs by Xiluoya.

About the detailed usage %1$s, tap to view the document.
Use the pure black theme if night mode is enabled
Help us translate %s into your language
For rooted devices, Xiluoya is able to start automatically on boot
You can start Xiluoya service now.
Allow the app to use Xiluoya.
Can\'t start service because root permission is not granted or this device is not rooted.

Legacy Xiluoya has been deprecated since March 2019. Also, legacy Xiluoya does not work on newer Android systems.

Please ask the developer of %1$s to update.

%1$s has modern Xiluoya support, but it\'s requesting legacy Xiluoya. This could because Xiluoya is not running, please check in Xiluoya app.

Legacy Xiluoya has been deprecated since March 2019.
Connect to 127.0.0.1:5555 and start the service

adbd is not listening on TCP right now.

Run this once on a computer://n//nadb tcpip 5555

After that, this button starts the service on-device, no computer needed, until the phone reboots.
Not installed. Xiluoya ships the LSPatch package, tap below to install it on-device — no computer needed.
Version %1$s installed. Tap below to open.
No root detected on this device
Pick an APK, apply the LSPatch patch, then install it back. Everything runs on-device.
No computer needed. The phone starts the service by itself over 127.0.0.1. Requires adb tcpip to have been run once.
